name: quotebank
title: Quote bank
description: Quotations, poems, prose passages, proverbs and lyrics by public figures, mirrored from a private quote bank. This file is the schema: tools/mirror.py publishes only these columns and checks every row against them.

resources.name: quotes
resources.description: One row per entry, sorted by id.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Permanent entry id, Q0001 upward; never renumbered or reused. Gaps are entries that stay private.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: The text, unchanged from the source. Verse lines are separated by ' / '.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Language of the text: ISO 639-1 code, or ISO 639-3 where there is none (grc, pi).

fields.name: transliteration
fields.description: Romanisation of text not in Latin script; lines separated by ' / '.

fields.name: entry_type
fields.description: quote (sentence or short passage), prose (longer passage), poem, lyric (song text), proverb.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Person who said or wrote it; for film and television, the character. Empty: anonymous, proverb or unknown. Joins authors.name.

fields.name: source_work
fields.description: Most specific source known: work, chapter, letter, episode.

fields.name: category
fields.description: One per entry: a theme (Love), a tradition (Stoicism) or a medium (Film & Television).

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Keywords, separated by ';' (a list in quotes.json).

fields.name: attribution
fields.description: Sourcing status. verified: traced to a named source. paraphrase: renders a real passage, shortened or reworded. reattributed: author corrected. unverified: searched for and not found; the search is in notes. original: original-language text of a translated entry. as-given: taken as written; unchecked.

fields.name: translation_group
fields.description: Shared by renderings of the same passage, tg-001 upward. The original-language text, where held, has attribution original.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Findings of the sourcing check, and other remarks.

resources.name: authors
resources.description: One row per author name used in quotes.csv, sorted by name (case-insensitive).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Author name exactly as in quotes.author.

fields.name: status
fields.description: bio (person or group with a biography), alias (another spelling of a bio row), traditional (anonymous or handed-down source, or an unnamed character).

fields.name: alias_of
fields.description: For alias rows: the name of the bio row.

fields.name: born
fields.description: Year (1809), 'AD 121', 'c. 563 BC', 'c. 6th c. BC', 'unknown' or 'n/a (fictional)'. For groups, the founding year.

fields.name: died
fields.description: Same forms as born. Empty for the living.

fields.name: birthplace
fields.description: Place name as it is called today.

fields.name: deathplace
fields.description: Place name as it is called today.

fields.name: bio
fields.description: One paragraph, not starting with the name.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Remarks, e.g. disputed dates.

fields.name: checked
fields.description: Sources the bio was verified against.

resources.name: quotes-json
resources.description: quotes.csv as JSON: {"count": N, "entries": [...]}, one object per row with the same fields; tags is a list.
